name: Times Mirror Co. v. Superior Court
summary: The Times Mirror sought access to communications between Governor Deukmejian and his legal counsel relating to pending litigation. The California Supreme Court recognized a common-law deliberative process privilege protecting candid pre-decisional communications and held that § 6255 (now § 7922.000) permits withholding when the public interest in nondisclosure clearly outweighs the public interest in disclosure.
holding: Government Code § 6255 (catch-all exemption, now § 7922.000) provides that an agency may refuse to disclose records if the public interest in their nondisclosure clearly outweighs the public interest in disclosure. Pre-decisional deliberative communications are protected by a common law privilege analogous to the federal deliberative process privilege. The exemption requires a specific, particularized showing that disclosure would inhibit frank internal deliberation.

legal_definitions.definition: A common-law privilege protecting pre-decisional, deliberative communications that are part of an agency's decision-making process, when disclosure would inhibit the free exchange of ideas necessary for effective government.
legal_definitions.context: Recognized as a basis for invoking § 6255 catch-all exemption (now § 7922.000).

legal_definitions.definition: Under § 6255 (§ 7922.000), the agency must demonstrate that the public interest served by nondisclosure 'clearly outweighs' the public interest served by disclosure; mere inconvenience or embarrassment is insufficient.

relevance_to_audit: Defines the § 6255 / § 7922.000 balancing test; critical when agencies invoke the catch-all exemption. ODIA L-3 (Exemption Misapplication) must apply this standard to evaluate improper § 6255 claims.

key_quotes.text: The public interest in nondisclosure must clearly outweigh the public interest in disclosure; it is not sufficient that nondisclosure is merely in the public interest.
key_quotes.context: Establishing the high threshold for the catch-all § 6255 exemption.

procedural_posture: Petition for writ of mandate to compel disclosure; denied in part
subsequent_treatment: Leading authority on the § 6255 / § 7922.000 balancing test; applied to deliberative process and other catch-all exemption claims
